candidate_windows.window_text: We use pre-trained parameters from BART-base (Lewis et al., 2020) to initialized our model, which takes a maximum 512 input token sequence and consists of a 6-layer transformer encoders and another 6-layer transformer decoders (Vaswani et al., 2017) with 12 attention heads and 768 word dimensions. For model fine tuning, we use Adam with learning rate of $3\mathrm{e} - 5$ , $\beta_{1} = 0.9$ , $\beta_{2} = 0.999$ , L2 weight decay of 0.01, learning rate warm up over the first 10,000 steps, and linear decay of learning rate. Our models are trained with a 4-card 32GB memory Tesla V100 GPU, and implemented with the Huggingface's Transformer (Wolf et al., 2020).
